 "data": "@startuml
start
:Customer clicks on a specific product card;
:Frontend extracts productId and sends fetch request;
:Backend queries product details from Database;

if (Product exists?) then (Yes)
 :Retrieve full details (Description, Sizes, Colors, Images, Price);
 :Render Product Details Page;
 :Display detailed view & Purchase options to Customer;
else (No)
 :Display \"Product Not Found\" Error Page;
endif

stop
@enduml",

</UserObject> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
actor Customer
participant \"ProductCard (UI)\" as Card
participant \"ProductDetailPage (UI)\" as DetailUI
participant \"ProductController\" as Controller
database \"Database\" as DB

Customer -> Card: clickOnProduct(productId)
activate Card
Card -> DetailUI: navigateToProductPage(productId)
deactivate Card

activate DetailUI
DetailUI -> Controller: getProductDetails(productId)
activate Controller
Controller -> DB: SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = productId
activate DB
DB --> Controller: return productData (details, images, sizes, colors)
deactivate DB

Controller --> DetailUI: return HTTP 200 OK (detailsJSON)
deactivate Controller
DetailUI --> Customer: renderProductView(data)
deactivate DetailUI
@enduml",
 "config": null
